mapper.update: update doctor set description = #{description} where id = #{id}
update doctor set reservation_resource = reservation_resource + #{releaseNum} where id = #{doctorId}
mapper.select: select id as doctor_id,reservation_resource from doctor
select d.id, d.department_id, a.name as departmentName, d.name, d.email, d.phone, d.password, d.description from doctor d left join department a on d.department_id = a.id
select d.name, dep.name, d.phone, d.description, d.reservation_resource as resourceNum from doctor d left join department dep on d.department_id = dep.id where d.name like concat('%',#{keyName},'%')
